_comment: Edit this file to configure your experiment. Values here override config.py defaults. Only the fields you change need to be present. Set EXPERIMENT to the name of your data folder under data/.
_snr_comment: SNR floor: set SNR_FLOOR_ENABLED=true to strip flat baseline bins (recommended for the standard pipeline).
_stats_comment: Univariate test + FDR, bootstrap stability, overlap null, and PLS-DA Q2 diagnostics. Lower the iteration counts (or set the RUN_* flags false) for faster iteration.
